A1.justification: Both supplied PDFs contain the same readable 11-page UniPart paper, with matching scientific text, equations, figures, tables, and references. Neither contains an appendix, although both refer to supplementary materials.

before.justification: Section 4 reports original generation and segmentation experiments, quantitative results in Tables 1-2, and qualitative component ablations in Figures 6-7.

after.justification: Section 4 retains the original generation and segmentation results in Tables 1-2 and the qualitative ablations in Figures 6-7.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1-3.3 retain the identical Geom-Seg VAE, whole-level diffusion, latent segmentation procedure, and dual-space part-level diffusion.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same curated ABO, Objaverse, and Objaverse-XL data and the same image-guided part-generation and 3D segmentation evaluation coverage.

E2.justification: Both retain HoloPart, OmniPart, PartCrafter, PartPacker, and X-Part in the generation comparison; SAMesh, PartField, and P3-SAM in the segmentation comparison; and Hunyuan3D-2.1 as the reconstruction reference.

E3.justification: The evaluation protocols are identical: 100 objects for generation, 50 meshes with 536 annotated parts for segmentation, the same CD/F-score/mIoU metrics, rotation selection, normalization, and 4,096-point segmentation comparison.

E4.justification: The reconstruction comparison and ablations in Figures 2, 6, and 7 are identical, including canonical-space generation, local attention, space embeddings, global conditioning, and latent-versus-point conditioning.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run or seed counts, confidence intervals, error bars, or statistical significance tests. Uncertainty reporting is unchanged.

E6.justification: All table entries and qualitative results are identical. Table 1 retains UniPart's CD of 0.1311 and F-scores of 0.5565 and 0.8052; Table 2 retains its mIoU of 0.7222.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and Equations 1-5, including the VAE losses, flow-matching objective, and local/global attention formulations, are identical.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, contribution list, and conclusion retain identical claims about unified geometry-segmentation latents, two-stage generation, and segmentation and geometry quality.

C2.justification: The explanations of latent conditioning and dual-space generation are unchanged. Both retain the same limitations concerning unvalidated scene generation and unexplored voxel-based representations.

D1.justification: Implementation and reproducibility information is identical, including data processing, Hunyuan3D-2.1 initialization, optimizer settings, eight 80GB A800 GPUs, and batch size 32.

R1.justification: Section 2, the positioning relative to prior work, and all 45 numbered reference entries are unchanged.

P1.justification: Only the first-page arXiv margin stamp changes from v1 dated 10 December 2025 to v2 dated 24 February 2026. The title, authors, prose, terminology, and section structure are identical.

P2.justification: The teaser, Figures 1-7, Tables 1-2, captions, and their placement are identical. Pages 2-11 render identically; the first-page difference is confined to the version/date stamp.

improvement.justification: The supplied versions have identical scientific content, evidence, implementation details, and substantive presentation. Updating the arXiv version/date stamp does not meaningfully change clarity, rigor, reproducibility, or overall paper quality.
